adminFeeNote: Caldova Super & Pension admin fee is charged separately on the whole account balance: 0.30% on the first $250,000, 0.15% on $250,000–$1,000,000, 0.05% on $1,000,000–$2,000,000, nil above $2,000,000, plus a $180 p.a. account-keeping fee.

sectorNotes: Fully passive — each sleeve tracks a market-capitalisation-weighted index; rebalanced quarterly back to target.
Same 60/40 growth/defensive split as Balanced, but no active managers or liquid alternatives — this is why the fee is lower.
All holdings are daily-priced and liquid exchange-traded funds.
suitableFor: Cost-conscious investors who want a diversified 60/40 mix without active management and have a timeframe of at least 5 years.
importantInformation: General information only — not personal financial advice. Caldova Managed Portfolios are fictional products used in the Wealth Team in a Day scenarios.
